# PetVax

> PetVax brings dog and cat vaccinations and microchipping to your home. It serves Hell's Kitchen and nearby neighborhoods in Manhattan, New York City, only.

Key facts:
- Service: at-home vaccinations and microchipping for dogs and cats
- Area served: Hell's Kitchen and surrounding neighborhoods, Manhattan, New York, NY
- Price: $75 per visit, including one vaccine; each additional vaccine during the same visit is $75; microchipping is $75
- Fastest way to book: text (347) 644-0551
- Book online: https://www.petvax.org/book.html
- Each visit includes a quick exam to make sure the pet is healthy enough to be vaccinated. PetVax sends a reminder one month before a booster is due.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.petvax.org/): services, prices, vaccine explanations and sample vaccination schedules
- [Book an appointment](https://www.petvax.org/book.html): online booking form

## Vaccines offered

Dogs, core: Rabies (legally required in New York), DHPPi (distemper, hepatitis, parainfluenza, parvovirus), Leptospirosis (strongly recommended in New York).
Dogs, non-core: Bordetella (kennel cough), Lyme, Canine Influenza.
Cats, core: Rabies (legally required in New York, even for indoor cats), FVRCP, Feline Leukemia Virus (recommended for kittens).

## Sample schedules

Puppies: 8, 12 and 16 weeks (distemper series; leptospirosis at 12 and 16 weeks; rabies at 12 weeks; optional Bordetella, Lyme and canine influenza).
Kittens: 8, 12 and 16 weeks (FVRCP series; feline leukemia at 12 and 16 weeks; rabies at 12 weeks).
Adult dogs: rabies and distemper every three years; Bordetella every 6 to 12 months; leptospirosis, canine influenza and Lyme yearly.
Adult cats: rabies and FVRCP every three years; feline leukemia every other year for at-risk cats.

Schedules are examples. PetVax tailors a schedule to each pet.
